macros.name: CopyList
macros.doc: Copy a list in another one.

macros.name: CountList
macros.doc: Count the number of elements in the list #1. Store it in #2.

macros.name: ExtractFirstItem
macros.doc: \ExtractFirstItem extract the first value of a list and store it in a macro.

macros.name: ExtractItem
macros.doc: \ExtractItem behaves like \ExtractFirstItem but the element extracted is the one indicated by its index.

macros.name: ExtractLastItem
macros.doc: Extract the last element of list #1 and store it in #2.

macros.name: ExtractList
macros.doc: ExtractList extract a list from a list.

macros.name: ExtractRandomItem
macros.doc: \ExtractRandomItem works like the previous \ExtractItem. Here, the index is selected randomly by the computer.

macros.name: ForEachFirstItem
macros.doc: \ForEachFirstItem typesets #3 for each element of the list #1 extracting the actual first element (stored in #2).

macros.name: ForEachLastItem
macros.doc: \ForEachLastItem typesets #3 for each element of the list #1 extracting the actual last element (stored in #2).

macros.name: ForEachRandomItem
macros.doc: \ForEachRandomItem typesets #3 for each element of the list #1 extracting randomly an element (stored in #2).

macros.name: GetFirstItem
macros.doc: \GetFirstItem put the first value of a list into a macro.

macros.name: GetItem
macros.doc: Get the element of rank #2 of list #1 and store it in #3.

macros.name: GetLastItem
macros.doc: Get the last element of list #1 and store it in #2.

macros.name: GetList
macros.doc: \GetList copy a sub-list from a list.

macros.name: GetRandomItem
macros.doc: \GetRandomItem give the value of a randomly selected element of a list.

macros.name: InsertFirstItem
macros.doc: \InsertFirstItem writes a value at the beginning of a list and shift other values to the end of the list.

macros.name: InsertItem
macros.doc: Add an element #3 at the position #2 of the list #1.

macros.name: InsertLastItem
macros.doc: \InsertLastItem is like \InsertFirstItem but the insertion is made at the end of the list.

macros.name: InsertList
macros.doc: Insert List #3 to the list #1 starting at index #2.

macros.name: InsertRandomItem
macros.doc: Insert element #2 in a random position of list #1.

macros.name: RandomItemizeList
macros.doc: \RandomItemizeList which build an itemize list with random placement of items.

macros.name: ReadFieldItem
macros.doc: randomlist allow to read each field with the macro \ReadFieldItem.

macros.name: ReadFileList
macros.doc: In order to make life easy, randomlist allow to read whole database from files with the command \ReadFileList.

macros.name: RLfor
macros.doc: Loop without group.

macros.name: SetFirstItem
macros.doc: Set the first element of list #1 with value #2.

macros.name: SetItem
macros.doc: Set the #2 element of list #1 with value #3.

macros.name: SetLastItem
macros.doc: Set the last element of list #1 with value #2.

macros.name: SetList
macros.doc: \SetList allow to give multiple values to a list.

macros.name: SetRandomItem
macros.doc: Set element in a random position of list #1 with value #2.
